title: Morrow
summary: A bright new ritual for a better kind of everyday.
tagline: Fresh starts. Good bread. A brighter everyday.
introduction: A bakery and coffee concept built around the optimistic pull of tomorrow and the small rituals that make today feel better.

heroArtwork.alt: Orange croissant, rising sun and flower illustration.

heroImage.alt: Morrow orange bakery packaging, takeaway coffee cup and almond croissant.

challenge.heading: A familiar category asking for a fresh reason to visit.
challenge.copy: Morrow was entering a busy bakery and coffee market with a strong product but no clear point of difference. The brand needed to make everyday quality feel optimistic, contemporary, and worth building into a routine.

contribution.heading: An identity with tomorrow in its step.
contribution.copy: We shaped a simple strategic idea around fresh starts, then created a bright identity, direct verbal style, and digital system that moves easily from bread bags and cups to daily menus and seasonal announcements.

galleryLabel: A bright identity for the everyday ritual

outcome.heading: A daily ritual with a point of view.
outcome.copy: Morrow now feels recognisable, useful, and full of forward energy, giving the team a brand that can support the daily rhythm of the shop and the next stage of its growth.
